## Accommodation Inventory (3 Private Suites with Balconies)
Each suite spans ~400 sq. ft with an attached private balcony, king bed, and luxury en-suite bathroom:
1. **The Himalayan Suite (Master Suite 1)**: ~400 sq. ft master suite, panoramic valley-facing glazing, attached private viewing balcony, handcrafted king bed with orthopedic mattress, dedicated reading chairs, private en-suite bathroom with glass shower cubicle. URL: https://themukteshwarbungalow.in/rooms/the-himalayan-suite
2. **The Imperial Suite (Suite 2)**: ~400 sq. ft heritage retreat, exposed natural timber rafters, attached private viewing balcony, artisanal brass accents, peaceful outlook over pine canopy and garden ridge, private en-suite bathroom with walk-in shower. URL: https://themukteshwarbungalow.in/rooms/the-imperial-suite
3. **The Signature Himalayan (Suite 3)**: ~400 sq. ft corner suite, direct walkout to outdoor veranda and attached private balcony, dual-aspect natural lighting, king bed, designer private en-suite bathroom. URL: https://themukteshwarbungalow.in/rooms/the-signature-himalayan

## Key Living & Social Zones
- **Dedicated Pure-Veg Cook/Chef Service**: Customized, freshly prepared home-style 100% pure vegetarian breakfast, lunch, and dinner prepared by the resident chef.
- **Private Manicured Lawn & Garden**: Open green lawn framed by oak and pine forests for sunrise Himalayan tea, morning yoga, relaxation, and cozy evening bonfires.
- **The Veranda Lounge**: Expansive glass-enclosed mountain living lounge designed for slow mornings and evening fireside conversations. (https://themukteshwarbungalow.in/veranda-lounge)
- **Veranda - Open Space**: Outdoor open-air stone terrace and sun deck overlooking the Kumaon mountain ranges, ideal for yoga and stargazing.
- **Fully Equipped Kitchen**: Complete residential kitchen with gas hobs, microwave, refrigerator, RO water purifier, and tableware for guest self-cooking and baby food prep. (https://themukteshwarbungalow.in/kitchen)

## Key Landmark Proximity Matrix
- Chauli Ki Jali: 8.5 km (~20 mins drive)
- Mukteshwar Dham Shiva Temple: 8.2 km (~20 mins drive)
- Bhalu Gaad Waterfall: 14 km (~30 mins drive + 30 mins trek)
- Bhatelia Market: 6.5 km (~15 mins drive)
- Kainchi Dham (Neem Karoli Baba Ashram): 38 km (~75 mins drive)
- Nainital (Naini Lake & Mall Road): 45 km (~90 mins drive)
- Kathgodam Railway Station: 58 km (~2 hrs drive)
- Pantnagar Airport (PGH): 88 km (~2.5 hrs drive)
